title: Delegation Result Envelope (FR-002)
description: Normalized outcome of a delegated task; identical shape for every backend so any backend's result reads the same way. Extraction contract (technical review 2026-08-05): the delegation prompt requires the backend to END its final message with a fenced JSON block conforming to this schema; the dispatcher extracts the LAST fenced JSON block, validates required fields with stdlib json, and never derives fields from prose. Fabricating content is forbidden: when no valid block is present, outcome=failure ('backend returned nothing usable'), attempted/changes stay empty, and the raw output is preserved at raw_output_path.

backend.description: Registry id of the producing backend (attribution, US3)

model.description: Resolved model/tier actually used; null when the backend default was used and not reported

outcome.description: partial = timed out or interrupted with salvageable state (FR-012)

attempted.description: What the backend attempted, in its own words (may be empty only when outcome=failure)

changes.description: Files/paths the backend reports touching; [] for read-only runs

succeeded.description: Explicit success signals (tests passed, repro confirmed, ...)

failed.description: Explicit failure signals; non-empty when outcome != success

follow_ups.description: Recommended next steps; includes the resume invocation when session_ref exists

session_ref.description: Backend thread/session/conversation id enabling resume (FR-015); null when not captured or unsupported

raw_output_path.description: Path to the job's output.txt (verbatim backend final message)

error.description: Actionable cause when outcome=failure (SC-004: never empty in that case)
